limits: Candidate19 verifies committed paused-checkpoint reconnect, not lossless recovery after losing the writer before final ACK.
The old timeout inquiry remains visible on B after reconnect; unobstructed UI use is not accepted.

Native PASS means the recorded scenario assertions passed. WORLD_KEYS omits allocationCounterHash; Candidate19 post-reconnect visual type counters differ 2902/3421 despite equal nextHandle=45029, then match after returning to A. All-stage exact allocator consistency is NOT accepted and no registry rewrite is justified by this observation alone.
Sale20 hit UsableMachine.OnMissionEnded NullReference during fixture preparation and performed zero sales. No Mission core fix is claimed.

Sale22 raw cleanup remains false after shared poll deadline leaked into diagnostics and stop_run. Later OS-confirmed process exit and explicit token-bound lock recovery are retained separately in sale22-explicit-lock-recovery.json.

Sale26 recorded a successful native LocalA application and equal post-sale critical hashes/nextHandle, but failed the old across-sale constant allocator expectation. Original dummy registration increments writer type counters twice and replica counters once per new handle; the registry itself was not changed to satisfy the test.

Sale28 runtime assertions passed 9/9, including four operation ledgers with 1/2/3/4 entries. Final merged logs repeat archived later-page records. Original archived files contain exactly four applications and preserve every live prefix byte; root check-sale28-proof.mjs verifies pinned hashes, prefix equality, sales and handoff floors without line deduplication. The QA merged-log collection defect still needs repair; no gameplay-core rewrite is justified.
Natural cross-day and complete NPC AI period continuity remain NOT_RUN; short tick samples are insufficient.
Known non-writer connection callbacks are fenced; a general routed restore for an already parked remote party is not implemented.
Historical Coop/E2E failures remain non-green; regression14 and regression16 added failures and their repairs are retained.
Previously policy-blocked cold-audit residual cleanup remains registered; no alternate deletion attempted.
